SELECT patient_id, sex, avg_wbc, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - overall_mean AS ratio_minus_mean
FROM (
  SELECT patient_id, sex, avg_wbc, avg_ratio, AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS overall_mean
  FROM (
    SELECT p.ID AS patient_id,
           p.SEX AS sex,
           AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc,
           AVG(CASE WHEN l.HGB IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT != 0
                    THEN 1.0 * l.HGB / l.HCT END) AS avg_ratio
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
  )
)
WHERE avg_ratio > overall_mean
ORDER BY ratio_minus_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
